{{Quote|Here we stand, at the extremity of our exertion, having cast behind us the idols of our fathers, to once again carry to our foe the penalties due their sacrilege. Come perdition or hard vacuum, the Republic expects that every citizen will do his duty.|Supreme Chancellor Contispex I, ''Fourth Inaugural Oration''|<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
'''Contispex''', eventually known as '''Contispex I''', was the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] from [[11,987 BBY]] to [[11,947 BBY]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and serving as a Republic [[Senator/Legends|senator]], Contispex was a member of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Pius Dea]] religious sect. Pius Dea orchestrated the impeachment of Supreme Chancellor [[Pers'lya]] and the election of Contispex, and [[Gender/Legends|he]] subsequently reformed the Republic government, granting economic and military power to fellow Pius Dea adherents. In [[11,965 BBY]], Contispex sanctioned a Republic [[First Pius Dea Crusade|crusade]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], which would become the first of a [[Pius Dea Crusades|series]] of similar anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] military campaigns during the subsequent [[Pius Dea Era|millennium]]. After a reign of four [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], Contispex stepped down in favor of his son, [[Contispex II]], and his descendants, either biological or ideological, continued to rule as Supreme Chancellors until [[10,966 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Rise of Contispex I===
{{Quote|Approximately 12,000 BBY a theocratic conspiracy, centuries in the offing, impeached Chancellor Pers'lya and placed its own man, Contispex, in the seat.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
[[File:Malkite_Poisoners.svg|thumb|right|250px|The Malkite Poisoners (emblem pictured) played a role in the rise of Supreme Chancellor Contispex I.]]
Contispex was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], at some point around the beginning of the [[Time/Legends|time]] period that lasted from [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] to [[11,000 BBY]] and that would eventually be known as the [[Pius Dea Era]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] was a member of the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] cult of [[Pius Dea]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 19: The Pius Dea Crusades}}</ref> Contispex rose to prominence in the [[Coruscant Merchants' Guild]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> and eventually became a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Codex" />

In [[11,987 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> Pius Dea brought about its centuries-old plans by<ref name="TTSP" /> having the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] impeached<ref name="Codex" /> and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and Contispex was elected as the new Chancellor.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Unknown to many, the [[Malkite Poisoners]], a secret society<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> based out of the<ref name="CSWE MalkitePoisoners">{{CSWECite|II|281|Malkite Poisoners}}</ref> remote<ref name="TEGtW" /> planet [[Malkii/Legends|Malkii]],<ref name="CSWE MalkitePoisoners" /> played a role in Contispex's rise to power.<ref name="TNEGtD" />

===A religious Chancellor===
{{Quote|Interspecies tensions had simmered since the very dawn of the Republic; Contispex and his successors exploited prohuman sentiment for increasingly violent jihads on what was then its periphery.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
At one point, as noted in ''[[Fourth Inaugural Oration]]'', Contispex spoke about the need for the Republic citizens to do their "duty," as related to punishing its enemies for their "sacrilege," after they had abandoned the "idols" of their forebears.<ref name="TTSP" /> The Supreme Chancellor overhauled the government of the Republic, granting economic and military power to fellow adherents of the Pius Dea faith, with important government posts becoming reserved for members of the cult's hierarchy within a single generation. Those who refused to convert to Contispex's religion were quickly purged. During the reign of Contispex, Pius Dea also began preaching that fallen communities should be restored to purity by purging the elements within them which could not be redeemed.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:FirstPiusDeaCrusade-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Contispex I sanctioned the First Pius Dea Crusade.]]
Contispex and Pius Dea exploited both pro-Human sentiment in the Republic<ref name="TTSP" /> and tensions within the<ref name="Codex" /> long-unpopular [[Hutt Empire]]<ref name="TTSP" />&mdash;the realm of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which had preyed for centuries on Republic's [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] at its periphery. In [[11,965 BBY]], the Chancellor sanctioned a pre-emptive strike against the Hutts<ref name="TEGtW" /> in the form of an invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="TTSP" /> In what became known as the [[First Pius Dea Crusade|first]] of the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] advanced<ref name="TEGtW" /> in Contispex's name<ref name="CSWE Contispex">{{CSWECite|I|139|Contispex, Supreme Chancellor}}</ref> beyond the Republic's borders toward Hutt Space.<ref name="TEGtW" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|His opening target was the perennially unpopular Hutt Empire, but the program soon expanded to unbelievers of less evident threat.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
In [[11,947 BBY]], Contispex, who eventually became known as Contispex I, stepped down from his position in favor of his son, [[Contispex II]]. By that time, the Republic had effectively come under the control of fanatic followers of Pius Dea.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Contispex's subsequent descendants continued to [[Contispex dynasty|inherit]] the Chancellorship,<ref name="Codex" /> and by the last centuries of the Pius Dea Era, every new Chancellor, whether related to Contispex I or not, took the name "Contispex" upon attaining office, with [[Contispex XIX]] serving as the final Pius Dea leader of the Republic until his [[Battle of Uquine|deposition]] in [[10,966 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] following the rise of Contispex I, under him and his successors the Republic carried out at least [[Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade|thirty-four]] crusades at various regions along its borders, aimed at both the Hutts and other species neighboring&mdash;and constituting&mdash;the Republic, with the [[Third Pius Dea Crusade|Third Crusade]] already taking place in [[11,939 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> As a result, millennia-long cultural integration was undone,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and tensions were deepened between the Core Worlds and [[Rim]]ward regions that would go on to last for tens of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned Contispex I in the article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="TTSP" />

==Personality and traits==
During his membership in the Coruscant Merchants' Guild, Contispex became legendary for his devotion to the Pius Dea religion. He also notably opposed corruption and vice and did not tolerate any individuals who did not share his high standards.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Contispex was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]].<ref name="TNEC" /> He was identified as Contispex I by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
